key.name: last-connected-ip
key.description: The IP address of the last device that was successfully connected to. This will be used as the default value when the app opens.

key.name: discovered-devices
key.description: JSON-encoded list of devices found during the last scan, including IP and latency.

key.name: keyboard-shortcuts
key.description: JSON-encoded dictionary mapping action names to Gdk key names. Empty dict means use defaults.

key.name: tv-ip
key.summary: TV IP address for Input button routing
key.description: IP address of the TV device. When configured, Input button commands will be sent to this TV instead of the connected device (useful for devices like Mi Box that don't support Input button).

key.name: last-connected-device-name
key.description: The manufacturer name of the last successfully connected device. Used for verification during auto-connect.

key.name: last-connected-device-model
key.description: The model name of the last successfully connected device. Used for verification during auto-connect.

key.name: tv-device-name
key.description: The manufacturer name of the TV device for Input button routing.

key.name: tv-device-model
key.description: The model name of the TV device for Input button routing. Used for verification during auto-connect.

key.name: home-assistant-mode
key.description: When enabled, buttons are sent through Home Assistant's Android Debug Bridge integration instead of the Android TV Remote protocol.

key.name: home-assistant-url
key.description: Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, e.g. https://ha.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8123. The access token is stored separately in the config directory.

key.name: home-assistant-entity
key.description: The remote entity of the TV's Android Debug Bridge integration that receives the commands.
